name: OpenDisplay tag
description: An OpenDisplay BLE e-paper tag, driven by the tesserae-opendisplay bridge. Tesserae renders a full-colour PNG; the bridge polls the frame over REST and pushes it to the tag over Bluetooth LE with the py-opendisplay SDK, which dithers for whatever panel the tag advertises. One bridge drives many tags. The panel dimensions here are a placeholder: the bridge registers each tag with its real advertised size, so the composition renders at the correct aspect. REST-polled, honours sleep_interval_s (echoed back as next_poll_s).

panel.name: OpenDisplay tag (placeholder; bridge sets the real size)

sleep_interval_s.label: Sleep interval
sleep_interval_s.help: How long the bridge sleeps between frame polls for this tag. BLE image pushes are slow, and e-paper updates infrequently, so a longer interval is usually right. Custom value is in seconds.
